episode_title: 143 - Building What's Next: How Hartford Interns are Shaping the Future

real_qa.q: How many interns and young professionals attended the Hype Intern Mixer in Hartford?
real_qa.r: More than 180 interns and young professionals from companies across the Hartford region gathered on Nassau's courtyard for the Hype Intern Mixer, one of the area's largest intern networking events, hosted in partnership with the Metro Hartford Alliance and Hype (Hartford Young Professionals and Entrepreneurs).

real_qa.q: What is the Travelers Promise and how do interns at Travelers incorporate it into their work?
real_qa.r: Tracy Rose, an internal comms intern at Travelers, mentioned learning about the Travelers Promise and how to incorporate it in editorial and communications work, including editing and proofreading tasks.

real_qa.q: What is the Data Science Leadership and Development Program at Travelers?
real_qa.r: Alex is a summer intern at Travelers in the Data Science Leadership and Development Program, recently finished with a doctorate degree and is transitioning into a new career at the company.
real_qa.requete: Travelers Data Science Leadership Development Program

real_qa.q: What does Nassau Financial Group's service team do regarding insurance policies?
real_qa.r: Cameron Hurley, a service intern at Nassau Financial Group, looks at policies and works on rehabilitating them, applying mathematical knowledge from university to real-world insurance settings.
real_qa.requete: Nassau Financial Group service policy rehabilitation

real_qa.q: What is the primary focus of Brian Thomas's cybersecurity internship at Talcott Financial Group?
real_qa.r: Brian Thomas is a cybersecurity intern at Talcott Financial Group focused on being immersed in AI security, specifically dealing with how to secure AI systems and keep data safe from threat actors using AI.
real_qa.requete: Talcott Financial Group cybersecurity AI internship
